license_scope: Pinned upstream README states CC BY 4.0 applies to documentation/content in assets, content, and data folders. All three corpus documents are in content/ or data/.
storage: Full unmodified source snapshots and upstream license evidence are local ignored data/public-cases/policy/. Only short attributed evidence excerpts, dataset labels and this provenance manifest are intended as reviewable example artifacts. No publish, commit or push performed.
offset_convention: Unicode code points in complete UTF-8 raw Markdown file, zero-based, end-exclusive. Paths are repository-relative.

rendered_verification.method: Author read the two official docs.github.com pages with web browsing and compared policies with the same raw document bodies; no full renderer executed.
rendered_verification.limits: Raw Markdown preserves unresolved Liquid tokens and transclusion directives. Only the separately snapshotted free-access reusable is evaluated. Other reused body content, menu steps, exact UI labels, seat-assignment auto-cancellation and detailed recovery procedures are excluded.
